movement-prompt.txt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create one NEW finished 4-by-4 animation sprite atlas on a genuine transparent background: exactly sixteen isolated full-body poses. The attached image is the APPROVED CANONICAL ONIX identity and wardrobe, not a layout to repeat. Match this SAME adult BLACK DOMESTIC CAT exactly: yellow feline eyes, triangular ears without tufts, short black fur/cool charcoal highlights, slim long curling black tail, dark petrol green sleeveless vest, ochre belt/sash, ivory paw wraps, dark brown trousers, one copper brooch. Same face, proportions, clothing and materials in every frame; never a lynx/panther, no redesign. Painterly 2D Brasa gouache with restrained rim light and legible dark contours; not chibi, not plush, not 3D.
Square transparent PNG, a strict invisible 4 columns × 4 rows grid. All sixteen bodies look toward SCREEN RIGHT in the same side-three-quarter view, including hurt/fallen frames. One common physical scale; standing body height only 65–70% of a cell, with 12% clear gutters. Entire ears, tail, paws and sash INSIDE each cell; compact tail curve, no overlaps between cells. Fixed orthographic camera and shared projected floor per row. Do not enlarge crouched, curled, fallen or airborne characters. Each body has coherent shoulder-elbow-wrist joints, natural feline paws, torso rotation and stable leg anatomy; no arm growing from neck, inflated fists or extra limbs. Complete single silhouette per pose, no detached objects.
No floor, cast shadows, grids, checkerboard pixels, text, numbers, labels, speed lines, dust, smoke, weapons, glow particles or detached effects. Export actual RGBA PNG with fully transparent alpha-zero empty space.
The 16 DIFFERENT movement poses, row-major, exactly one each:
ROW 1: (1) guard_shift: relaxed ready guard, weight shifts; (2) step_back: rearward defensive step, torso upright; (3) charge_crouch: compressed low forward-ready stance; (4) heavy_windup: back shoulder turns, wrapped paw drawn rearward.
ROW 2: (5) quick_windup: short compact arm preparation; (6) quick_extend: rightward straight punch, natural paw and slightly bent elbow; (7) follow_through: body rotates just after punch, second arm guarding; (8) recovery: retract striking paw, returning to balance.
ROW 3: (9) dash_lean: torso leans into sprint; (10) dash_stride: forward running step, extended rear leg, compact tail; (11) jump_start: pushing off ground with bent legs; (12) jump_apex: both feet airborne, compact legs and guards, leaving clear transparent gap to virtual floor.
ROW 4: (13) jump_strike: airborne forward paw strike toward right, same size; (14) jump_fall: descending legs prepare to touch floor, face right; (15) landing: both hindpaws grounded, knees bend deeply to absorb; (16) guard_settle: restored upright guard.
Keep all sixteen readable and anatomically connected. No duplicated row, missing pose or montage objects.
